summary: Round 16, rating head 06aea43. The cabin and studio renders come from the w16 build at 17:24, before bff7fba, which is a w16 in-progress pillow-lens commit and is NOT rated here; my own shots use the same build. The post-w15 tweaks work where it mattered most. (1) The aisle-end posts and door leaves now read as pale, near-plain cream in the cabin. In q06 the door (600-640 x 330-520) is (168,168,166) with hp 0.042, where w15 had (164,162,159) and hp 0.077. The cabinet/door luma ratio is 136/167 = 0.81 (w15 0.92). For c_27312, with the same boxes I use for the photo (door 440-490 x 260-420 (179,178,171), cabinet 345-420 x 340-430 (138,129,119)), it is 0.73. The dash streaks on the leaves are gone (z_q06.png); o2 shows the post in studio light as a plain cream panel in its charcoal frame, which matches c_27312 / c_27314. (2) The blotchy dark smudges in the cabinet ash are softer at gain 2.2, but the grain still reads as soft wavy cathedral arcs with low fine-scale contrast: hp 0.040-0.046 against 0.088-0.097 in c_27312 / c_27315, and warmer (R/B 1.24-1.27 against official 1.04-1.16). The real veneer is a straight, fine pinstripe (ash_cmp.png). (3) The webbing at #243440 still reads slate-teal in studio light (78,102,124). That is fine: c_27316 shows a teal belt (63,101,134) and omaat_room_15 a grey-teal one, so I withdraw my w15 low. The chrome buckle still reads as a matte grey plate without an environment to reflect, and the latch tongue floats as a pale tag about 3 cm away from its stub (o3). Still open at this head: the pillows are rigid bevelled boards (o3, r7, q09; bff7fba addresses this but is unrated); the bundle film is invisible, and only a blue strip on a white pad peeks out, where omaat_room_15 / kn_8 show a ~10 cm film-wrapped bundle front with strong glints; and the O comforter is still a crisp cross/T (r9). Lighting (not scored): the q09 shells are (97,102,112) against c_27314 (71,69,80). The q10 shells are now close (96,100,114 against 86,82,96). The studio sofa reads lilac. With the last medium from w15 mostly fixed and only low items plus the ash character left, I rate the area 8.5: clearly the same product, with minor material and soft-goods differences.

issues.detail: Cabinet / table ash: soft wavy bands and weak pinstripe, a little warm
issues.problem: The blotches are softer at 2.2, but the tile's 1-4 cm veneer bands now dominate and read as cathedral arcs, while the fine straight pinstripe of the real ash is about half the photo contrast. The hue also leans yellow-beige against the cool greige of the official photos.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py:65 HP['j_ash'] 60 -> 20 (drop the >1.5 cm bands) and :70 ALONG['j_ash'] 6 -> 14 (straighter streaks), then re-cut tex_j_ash.png. Keep PHOTO_GAIN[19] at 2.2 or go to 2.6 once the bands are gone, so the pinstripe reaches hp ~0.07. Optionally SEATMAT.ash (09_seats.js:79) #b2a28b -> #b0a390 (R/B 1.28 -> 1.22, between official and in-flight). Layer 30 (doors) shares the tile; check the doors stay plain.

issues.detail: Boarding bundle: no visible film; the front strip is too narrow
issues.problem: In omaat_room_15 and kn_8 the film-wrapped duvet and pad stick out ~10 cm in front of the blue pillow with bright crinkle highlights. In the model only a 2-3 cm blue lip shows, with no glints.
issues.fix: 09c:285-286 (06aea43): move the pillows ~6 cm back, or shift roomBundle z by dir*0.06, so ~10 cm of bundle shows. Widen the glints to gBox(0.012, 0.002, 0.14-0.24), put 4-5 of them on the exposed front strip at y 0.508 in { c: '#eef0f6', r: 0.04 }, and add a film lip gRBox(0.47, 0.003, 0.012) along the front edge.

issues.detail: O comforter still a crisp cross/T outline
issues.fix: 09c duvetSheet (06aea43:311-331) and the O bounds: taper xr linearly from the table corner to the foot (no step), add 0.03*sin(9z+1.3) to both edges, wob 1.0 for O, and round the outline corners (r 0.06).

issues.detail: Latch tongue detached from its webbing stub; buckle reads matte
issues.problem: The tongue (0.32, -0.10) floats ~3 cm from its stub (0.34, -0.17), so it reads as a stray grey tag. The buckle shows no highlight.
issues.fix: 09c:73-74: put the tongue at the stub's end: M4.mul(CU, M4.trs(0.34, 0.050, -0.105, 0.3)), i.e. the stub centre + 0.065 along its axis at the same angle, and make it 0.03 x 0.045. For the buckle, a thin bright top bevel strip (gBox(0.046, 0.001, 0.004) in #f4f6f8 r 0.05) along its front edge fakes the reflection the studio cannot show.
